citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 9:40am on June
11th, 2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee by honking the horn of the vehicle while parked at the gate of
the property to attract attention, calling the phone number on file two separate times over a 30 minute period and leaving
voice messages. Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and
regulations. Continued failure to provide access is serious and may result in enforcement action.
End Section
